fixed.summary: A game that mounts the engine's TSX components (@origingame/engine/ui/components) runs on the native host: they are bundled and compiled with the game's TSX instead of loaded as external modules, which failed with "Export named 'Show' not found".
`mount` fills the UI's surface: a component's root lays out as in a full-screen column, so `absolute inset-0` covers the screen instead of collapsing to a zero-width box.
